Start date: 1599-12-18  
Subtract 31 weeks = 31 × 7 = 217 days.  
Add 4 more days → total subtract 221 days.  

1599-12-18 minus 221 days:  
December has 31 days, go back to 1599-11-18 (30 days back from 12-18).  
Remaining 221 − 30 = 191 days earlier.  
Go back through months:  
Nov (30 days) → 1599-10-19 (191−30=161 left)  
Oct (31 days) → 1599-09-18 (161−31=130 left)  
Sep (30 days) → 1599-08-19 (130−30=100 left)  
Aug (31 days) → 1599-07-19 (100−31=69 left)  
Jul (31 days) → 1599-06-18 (69−31=38 left)  
Jun (30 days) → 1599-05-19 (38−30=8 left)  
May (31 days) → 1599-04-18 (8−31 goes negative, so go into April).  

Actually, from 1599-05-19, subtract 8 more days → 1599-05-11.  

Check: 1599-05-11 to 1599-12-18 is 221 days?  
May: 31−11=20, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 18 → sum = 20+30+31+31+30+31+30+18 = 221 days. Yes.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1599-05-11
